text:
Leo Ramos: FYI LuminaCare (acct: LMC-4410) INV-9987 autopay failed. Processor returned `card_declined` + `fraud_suspected`. Invoice is €9,850.00 EUR. Card last4 1111 exp 06/25. Customer flagged usage spike (monthly tokens) — they disputed one line item.

billing-bot: AUTO-PAY ATTEMPT 1 failed for INV-9987. processor: Adyen. attempt_id: adv_9xS3… decline_code: fraud_suspected

Priya Singh: Do we have a dispute open on this invoice? CS/Jules? If they're disputing a line, we usually pause autopay until verified.

Jules (CS): Customer emailed refunds@luminahealth.com claiming unexpected overage. On call now — they asked us to hold charges while they review usage. They want to pay the undisputed portion by wire.

Leo Ramos: OK — propose: (A) Create a partial invoice for undisputed amount €6,400.00 and route wire instructions; (B) Pause autopay for disputed remainder; (C) set case for usage reconciliation. Thoughts?

Omar (Treasury): Wire OK but note EU SEPA preferred. Treasury requires remittance with invoice number, beneficiary ref, and SWIFT/IBAN. We also need to check currency conversion policy — do we accept EUR wires to USD account or need EUR account?

Priya Singh: We have a dedicated EUR rail for EU customers (acct EUR-TREAS-03). Send SOC-approved SEPA template. Also set account flag `hold-autopay-dispute=true`.

Jules (CS): Sending paylink for partial amount now: https://billing.redwood.com/pay/INV-9987?partial=6400&token=eyJ… (link expires 72h). Notifying customer to send remittance and upload proof.

billing-bot: Created case #FIN-8472 (usage-recon). Autopay paused for invoice INV-9987.

Leo Ramos: Approve waiving late fees for the disputed remainder while we investigate. If they pay partial within 5 business days mark invoice `PAID_PARTIAL`.

Omar (Treasury): Once SEPA clears, treasury will apply to INV-9987 if remittance matches. If they wire to USD by mistake, we may need to apply FX and inform customer of possible bank charges. Request they use our EUR IBAN to avoid deductions.

Priya Singh: Also set `fraud_review=true` on the account until dispute closes — Adyen flagged `fraud_suspected`. Security has been notified.

Jules (CS): Customer accepted partial payment flow on call. They'll send SEPA tonight and upload remittance. I'll update when they confirm.

Leo Ramos: Great. Timeline: Jules updates by EOD, Treasury watches for incoming SEPA, Priya leaves dispute open for usage team to reconcile, Leo to confirm fee waiver after final resolution.

Jules (CS): :white_check_mark: updating customer thread now.
